purpose: Revisit the all-or-none arity-3 atom after v1.7. The specific cardinality relaxations {0,1,3} and {0,2,3} are not projected-linear, but ALL_OR_NONE3 nevertheless has a different exact decomposition into two projected-linear GF(2) relations. Determine exactly what this buys globally and freeze the first obstruction to absorbing the clause layer into one side.

explicit_projected_linear_representation.projection_convention: For an even linear delta-matroid L on visible ports plus hidden h, project h existentially: X is visible-feasible iff X or X union {h} is feasible in L.

global_meaning.positive: Every degree-3 all-or-none variable constraint is exactly the conjunction of two pair-equality projected-linear constraints. Thus v1.7 did not rule out all projected-linear decompositions of ALL_OR_NONE3; it ruled out only the frozen cardinality-relaxation pair.
global_meaning.remaining_problem: The SAT factor system contains a third clause/inverter compatibility layer. Replacing each variable by A and B therefore yields a genuine three-way interaction, not automatically a two-delta-matroid intersection instance.

absorption_counterexample.A_variable: On ports {0,1,2}, impose 0=2; edge 3 is free.

delta_matroid_failure.claim: For every v in X symmetric-difference Y, X symmetric-difference {u,v} is infeasible (with v=u interpreted as toggling u once). Hence the symmetric-exchange axiom fails.

absorption_counterexample.consequence: Even one pair-equality projected-linear side combined with simple nonempty clause constraints need not remain a delta-matroid. Therefore the clause layer cannot be silently absorbed into A (or symmetrically B) before invoking ordinary two-way linear/projected-linear delta-matroid intersection.

algorithmic_consequence.new_positive_structure: ALL_OR_NONE3 admits a two-piece projected-linear decomposition over GF(2).
algorithmic_consequence.killed_shortcut: Absorb the clause layer into one projected-linear side and solve the remainder by a standard two-delta-matroid intersection theorem without proving additional structure.
not_killed: A bespoke polynomial algorithm for the special three-way system consisting only of clause nonempty relations plus two disjoint pair-equality systems
A nonlocal transformation that merges the clause layer and both equality layers while preserving exact SAT semantics
A specialized augmentation theorem for this Tovey-image structure

next_target.directive: Exploit the exact special structure rather than generic three-matroid intersection: clause constraints are disjoint nonempty relations and the two projected-linear systems are disjoint pair equalities whose local intersection is all-equal. Seek one polynomial augmentation/elimination procedure that preserves exact Boolean fanout and reconstructs a satisfying assignment. Reject generic triple-parity, rainbow-matching, hashing, or span relaxations that admit known false positives or NP-hard superclasses.
success_obligations: no hidden exponential branching/state/group algebra/field extension
